title: make audit's Rule 3/4 Firebase/Talker-confinement greps scan lib/ only, so tool/lib/dio_client.dart's raw Talker import is invisible to every gate
why: Rule 4 says raw Talker import is confined to core/logging/; tool/lib/dio_client.dart imports it directly to build a Talker-backed Dio logger. tool/lib/ is part of the same Dart package (it imports package:learning_tracker/core/... elsewhere in this batch), but the audit's Rule 1-4 checks are hardcoded `grep ... lib/ --include="*.dart"` and custom_lint (the other enforcement path) is currently crashing entirely per the baseline — so nothing today, and nothing that will resume working once custom_lint is fixed unless its scope is also checked, would ever catch a Firebase- or Talker-misuse regression introduced under tool/.
recommendation: Either extend the Rule 3/4 audit greps to also scan tool/lib/ (carving out this file with a stated justification — it's a dev-only CLI logger with no PII/Crashlytics surface), or add an explicit documented exemption for tool/ in coding-standards.md so the gap is a decision instead of a blind spot.
acceptance_criteria: coding-standards.md states whether tool/ is in scope for Rules 3/4
If in scope, make audit checks 2 and 4 cover tool/lib/ and dio_client.dart either routes through AppLogger or is added to a justified, named exemption
